title: Breadth-First Search of a Graph
constraints: Each neighbor is an integer from 0 to adj.length - 1.
inputFormat: Implement bfsOfGraph(adj), where adj[v] lists the outgoing neighbors of vertex v. Vertex labels are 0 through adj.length - 1.
outputFormat: An array of visited vertex labels in BFS order starting at 0. Inspect neighbors in their listed order; omit unreachable vertices.
